description: This file defines the 'IoUtil' class with utility methods for sending commands, waiting for responses, changing RPM, launching simulators, and connecting to hardware for a Java-based engine control software project.

classes.name: IoUtil
classes.description: Utility class for engine control commands and hardware interaction.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the engine and waits for confirmation, with timeout handling.

methods.name: sendCommand (overloaded)
methods.description: Sends a command with specified retry and total timeout.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a CountDownLatch to count down within a specified timeout.

methods.name: changeRpm
methods.description: Changes engine RPM by sending command and verifying via sensor update.

methods.name: waitForFirstResponse
methods.description: Waits for initial RPM sensor response to confirm start.

methods.name: launchSimulator
methods.description: Launches engine simulator process and establishes TCP connection.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: realHardwareConnect
methods.description: Establishes connection to real hardware over specified port.
